Je bent een coach voor je collega's, een sparringpartner voor depots en iemand die snel schakelt wanneer de planning plots helemaal anders loopt dan voorzien. 🛠️ Wat je gaat doen 1. Optimalisatie van Was- en Transportplanning Je stelt en past dagelijkse was- en transportplanningen aan op basis van binnenkomende orders en toekomstige verwachtingen. Door wasprestaties te monitoren en afwijkingen direct aan te pakken, zorg je ervoor dat klanten op tijd hun bestellingen ontvangen. 2. Voorraadbeheer Je beheert de voorraadniveaus en stemt vraag en aanbod op elkaar af om tekorten te voorkomen. Dit omvat het monitoren van depotcapaciteit en het organiseren van hergroeperingen in samenwerking met de planningsafdeling. 3. Transportuitvoering Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het opstellen en toezicht houden op transportplanningen. Dit houdt in dat je operationele rapporten raadpleegt, bevindingen met het management deelt en de juiste transportbedrijven selecteert voor een efficiënte uitvoering. 4. Management Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het team van Regio West en zorgt ervoor dat de prestaties van het team bijdragen aan het behalen van de bedrijfsdoelstellingen. Daarnaast ben je ook verantwoordelijk voor het budget en de onderhandelingen met transporteurs. 🔎 Wat wij zoeken Jij bent een probleemoplossende manager die assertief is en graag vooruit denkt. Je houdt van afwisseling, blijft kalm onder druk en neemt initiatief om gemaakte afspraken met depots en klanten na te komen. Met jouw communicatieve vaardigheden weet je effectief te schakelen tussen verschillende depots. Verder: 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring binnen de logistieke sector, met ervaring als manager. Ervaring met netwerkstudies en onderhandelen met transporteurs. Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Franse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een goede kennis van Excel (draaien van draaitabellen, grafieken, formules). SAP is een plus. Planmatig en organisatorisch ingesteld. 🎁 Wat wij aanbieden Een competitief salaris Extra-legale voordelen (groepsverzekering, maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering...) 20 vakantiedagen en 12 ADV-dagen per jaar. FlexPay-plan waarbij je je eindejaarspremie kan inruilen voor andere voordelen (fietslease, aankoop gsm, pensioensparen...) Werken aan circulaire oplossingen binnen een enthousiast en ambitieus team.

direction • Advise senior management on operational, maintenance, technical and business matters • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, governance requirements and industry standards • Maintenance, Project Management, Contract Management and/or Financial Management • Knowledge of Health & Safety, Quality Assurance and Quality Control procedures • Experience working within a review_candidates.title: Director, Bureau of Human Resources Management
review_candidates.description: ORGANIZATIONAL CONTEXT The Bureau of Human Resources Management is responsible for developing, leading and coordinating the implementation of UNESCO’s Human Resources Strategy in close collaboration with its key stakeholders, namely Member States, senior management and UNESCO personnel, ensuring that UNESCO has a diverse, high-skilled and committed workforce worldwide that can deliver the Organization’s mandate across its fields of competence. In this regard, the Bureau provides strategic HR support services to management and UNESCO employees by developing, recommending and facilitating the implementation of human resources policies, programmes and initiatives including those captured in the five-year Human Resources Strategy’s roadmap. In addition, the Bureau is also responsible for statutory operational services and activities essential for the effective delivery of the Organization’s programmes and the well-being of its workforce. OVERVIEW OF THE FUNCTIONS OF THE POST Under the direct supervision of the Assistant Director-General of the Sector for Administration and Management (ADG/ADM), and overall supervision of the Deputy Director-General, the Director of the Bureau of Human Resources Management (DIR/HRM) leads and coordinates the delivery of human resources management services across the Organization. The incumbent provides authoritative advice and support to the senior management on a broad range of human resources matters and contributes to the development and implementation of HR policies, programmes and initiatives in line with organizational priorities and operational requirements. The Director oversees the provision of integrated HR services, including workforce planning, recruitment, learning and development, performance management and staff engagement, ensuring effective and consistent application of policies and procedures. The incumbent leads a team of HR professionals and promotes efficient, client-oriented HR services that support the Organization in attracting, developing and retaining a competent and diverse workforce. The Director promotes awareness within UNESCO of the importance of human resources management for overall organizational performance and as such, will manage the implementation of HR reform initiatives through innovative HR policies and practices, while cultivating a culture of excellence, accountability and continuous improvement across the Organization. KEY ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES The Director shall be responsible for: Providing guidance and support to senior management on all human resources matters and emerging HR issues. Promoting awareness of sound human resources management practices and support initiatives aimed at fostering a values-based workplace culture, supporting work-life balance and wellbeing initiatives, gender equality, nurturing staff development through targeted programmes and policies and leveraging diversity as an advantage to improve performance and innovation. Leading and coordinating the formulation, development, implementation and communication of UNESCO’s Human Resources Strategy, HR policies, programmes and initiatives, ensuring alignment with evolving organizational needs. Supporting organizational change and HR reform initiatives positioning HRM as a proactive enabler and trusted partner in achieving organizational transformation, efficiencies and innovation. Leading the design and implementation of an integrated talent management framework encompassing workforce planning, recruitment, learning and development, and performance management, aligning HR policies and processes to create synergies and efficiencies and embedding diversity targets into all stages of the employee lifecycle. Providing expert advice to senior managers on the implementation of HR policies and processes. Ensuring the provision of critical business intelligence to senior management on workforce trends and emerging HR issues to enable data-driven decision-making and proactive workforce planning and resource allocation. Leading a team of HR professionals, setting clear objectives, monitoring performance and fostering collaboration that encourages innovation, service excellence, continuous learning and professional development. Managing the overall implementation of the approved work programme and budget for the Bureau, ensuring efficient work distribution and coordination of tasks, promotion of teamwork, communication and management information. Building and maintaining productive working relationships with internal and external stakeholders including Permanent Delegations, academic institutes, professional networks and HR service providers. Representing the Organization in joint staff–management meetings as well as in the various United Nations forums including the International Civil Service Commission (ICSC), the HR Network and, as appropriate, the High-Level Committee on Management (HLCM). Representing the Organization in governing body meetings as required. Long Description For further information on the specific above-mentioned programmes, candidates may consult our website: https://www.unesco.org/en, and/or the following documents: 41 C/4 (UNESCO’s Medium-Term Strategy for 2022 – 2029) and 43 C/5 (Draft UNESCO’s Programme and Budget for 2026 – 2029 quadrennium). REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS EDUCATION Advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in human resources, public or business administration or management, law, social or human sciences or other related fields. WORK EXPERIENCE A minimum of 15 years of progressively responsible professional experience at the national or international level in human resources, public or business administration, or a related field, of which a significant part at managerial level. Experience in leading change-related projects or programmes and/or implementing organizational transformation. SKILLS & COMPETENCIES Knowledge of, and commitment to, the Organization’s mandate, vision, strategic direction and priorities. High sense of professional integrity and political sensitivity; demonstrated ability to interact with a wide range of high-level partners. Strong managerial and leadership skills combined with demonstrated flexibility in leadership by performing and/or overseeing the analysis of complex human resources issues. Excellent judgment and decision-making abilities including strong analytical and negotiation skills. Thorough understanding and hands-on experience in human resources management and a sound knowledge of HR theory and general management concepts. Proven ability to motivate, administer and manage a large body of staff working in diverse human resources functions. Excellent interpersonal skills including the ability to manage relationships at all levels of the Organization as well as demonstrated ability to work in a multicultural environment whilst maintaining a high sense of objectivity and impartiality as well as sensitivity and respect for gender equality and diversity issues. LANGUAGES Excellent knowledge and drafting skills in one of the working languages (English or French) of the Organization and ability to work in the second language. For more information visit unesco.org/careers Application deadline (Midnight Paris Time) : 25/09/2026

review_candidates.title: Deployment Engineer (Civil & Structural)
review_candidates.description: Deployment Engineer (Civil & Structural) – Cable Landing Station OMS Group is a global, neutral, and integrated telecommunications infrastructure service provider, delivering end-to-end solutions across the digital value chain. From Submarine Cable Installation and Marine Maintenance to Cable Landing Stations, Network Backhaul, and Data Centre Connectivity, we are at the forefront of connecting the world. Our capabilities in Submarine Cable Installation and Marine Maintenance comprises installation and repair of deep and shallow water fibre-optic cable systems, shore end installation, engineering and subsea surveys. We are looking for a Civil & Structural Deployment Engineer to lead the on-site execution, installation, and commissioning of Cable Landing Stations (CLS), ensuring seamless deployment of civil and structural components. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver robust, scalable, and compliant infrastructure that powers submarine cable and terrestrial networks. If you thrive in hands-on, field-based roles and want to make a tangible impact, this is your opportunity to shape the future of telecommunications. Key Responsibilities: Lead on-site deployment of civil and structural components for Cable Landing Stations, including buildings, foundations, cable routes, trenching, ducting, and beach manhole structures. Coordinate with construction teams to ensure accurate and efficient installation of civil and structural elements. Oversee site preparation, including excavation, trenching, and foundation work, ensuring compliance with design specifications and safety standards. Manage and resolve field issues related to civil and structural deployment, ensuring minimal downtime and delays. Collaborate with electrical, mechanical, and telecom teams to ensure integrated and functional Cable Landing Station infrastructure. Conduct site inspections to verify quality, compliance, and adherence to engineering designs and regulatory requirements. Liaise with relevant government authorities and regulatory agencies to secure permits, approvals, inspections, and statutory clearances required for project deployment. Support commissioning activities, including testing, validation, and handover of civil and structural systems. Act as the technical liaison between field teams, vendors, and project stakeholders to ensure smooth deployment. Document and report on deployment progress, challenges, and solutions to project managers and engineering teams. Ensure compliance with local and international building codes, safety regulations, and industry standards. Key Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering (or equivalent). Minimum 5-8 years of experience in field deployment, construction, or installation of Cable Landing Stations (CLS), data centers, telecommunications facilities, industrial plants, or similar mission-critical infrastructure. Hands-on experience in site preparation, excavation, foundation and structural installation, cable trenching, and ducting. Strong knowledge of civil and structural engineering principles, construction methodologies, and safety and compliance standards. Proficiency in using site surveying and layout tools, construction management software (e.g., Primavera, MS Project), and AutoCAD or Revit (for field verification). Excellent problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and resolve deployment challenges in real time. Strong communication and coordination skills to work with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, and stakeholders. Proven experience liaising with government authorities and regulatory agencies, with a sound understanding of permitting, approvals, inspections, and statutory requirements. Ability to travel and work on field assignments (domestic or international). If you’re passionate about designing mission-critical infrastructure that connects the world, we’d love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Construction Project Manager F/H
review_candidates.description: Role Summary: As part of our UK Civil nuclear site activities, we are looking for Construction Project Managers to support our activities on site for Hinkley Point C project on the construction of the Turbine Hall for Units 1 and 2. As a Construction Project Manager, you will be the on‑site focal point responsible for contract, administrative, and organizational coordination of a single work package (mechanical, piping, steel structure). Working in close collaboration with the Construction Manager and the Contract Manager, you will ensure efficient communication between site teams, all project functions, subcontractors, and project stakeholders to solve what is impacting production. You will act as peer for the Construction manager who is responsible for the execution of the scope and the management of the supervision and workforce. Roles & Responsibilities: Contract & Administrative Support: Monitor contractual obligations in coordination with the Construction Manager and Contract manager. Prepare, support and track contractual correspondence, variations, claims, non-comformities, and formal notifications. Manage project documentation in support to execution teams (procedures, drawings, reports, quality files). Support preparation for internal and external audits. Project Coordination & Interface: Act as the daily interface between site teams, all project functions, subcontractors, and project partners. Deal with client on request on interface, progress, reporting, road blocker Prepare and participate in coordination meetings, planning reviews, and project performance discussions. Consolidate and communicate key information (progress, risks, deviations). Developing and streamlining process to meet site challenges. Reporting & Analysis: Produce weekly and monthly progress reports including KPIs, risks, and cost/schedule deviations. Monitor project trends and propose corrective actions when required. Maintain dashboards and project monitoring tools with SQDC approach (Safety, Quality, Delivery & Costs). Administration & Financial Follow‑up: Prepare inputs for invoicing, cost tracking, and subcontractor payments. Support procurement: purchase requests, commitments, order follow‑up. Contribute to budget monitoring with the project teams. Competencies: Proven experience in construction, industrial, or infrastructure project management. Strong understanding of contract management (EPC, subcontracting, variations). Proficiency in reporting tools and document management. Familiarity with EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) and quality aspects on industrial sites. Excellent communication and coordination skills. Strong analytical and organizational abilities. Ability to work in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders. Ability to work in a cross-functional, multi-cultural and international environment Rigor and ability to prioritize and adapt to time-constrained environments. Proficiency in planning management. Experience or Knowledge in the nuclear industry or experience on a power plant site would be a plus Language: English (fluent)
